verified_findings.finding: After successful CreateFeature, FeatureCount increments once and CoordinateCount adds the full Long helper result. Null/empty geometries skip counting; per-feature stored count is separately clamped to Int32.MaxValue.
verified_findings.provenance: agent exact emitted current-source action, independently verified

verified_findings.finding: WriteMeta writes both totals from stats as invariant strings into key/value metadata; failed layer/field/row creation returns preparation failure.
verified_findings.provenance: separate root current-source action using a previously source-confirmed writer lead

verified_findings.finding: ReadMeta checks cache format and requires both strict count parses; missing/malformed/signed/negative/overflow values reject metadata as Nothing, while valid zero is retained.
verified_findings.provenance: agent ReadMeta action plus current literal helper inspection, independently verified

verified_findings.finding: One CacheMeta accumulator is created per BuildCache attempt, passed through source-file or converted-document processing, checked against stored feature count and then persisted. Counts concern prepared written spatial features across that source, not viewport filtering.
verified_findings.provenance: ordinary independent source inspection, supplemented by tool-returned per-feature caller windows; not credited to agent navigation
